package.manifest: forever-package.json with deterministic per-table partial-section declarations only
package.partial_encrypted_tables: Use the v26/v27 per-table declaration contract for every selected table with TACT-declared available-source sections, including Map when partial: deterministic [{lookup, frame_ordinal, decoded_size}] bound to the containing DB2 path. A complete table has no declaration.
package.partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden in the package manifest; the same-named PLAN gate remains mandatory
package.global_partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden; no v25-style global or package-wide declaration is admitted
package.declaration_boundary: Only per-table partial_encrypted_tables declarations are admitted. Map follows the same v26/v27 rule, including exact ordered multi-frame coverage of each TACT-declared extent; no global or package-wide partial-section declaration is permitted. Resume rejects recovered global declarations and tables outside the selected profile before producer replay or final sealing.
package.active_empty_maps: An actually admitted active map remains in coverage and receives its mandatory tree and placement proof even when it has no placements or tiles; a missing, inactive or unknown row is never converted into an empty active map.

strict_wrappers.foreign_or_mixed_masks: rejected by each profile-specific verify and verify-links wrapper before coverage acceptance
strict_wrappers.shared_mask17: v28 and v29 sharing component mask 17 does not permit crossing layout version, coverage path, source or coverage profile, domain closure, selection, or publication profile
strict_wrappers.zero_selection_aliases: requested_map=0 and MapSelection::MapAndAncestors(0) are rejected and never treated as MapSelection::All

context.binding: The v29 coverage context and sealed package context must match each other and the canonical v29 PLAN, including RCVGEO1 version 2, available coverage v2, MapSelection::All and mask 17. Mask 16, every foreign mask, and every v28 selected-map context reject even though v28 also uses mask 17.

source_policy.db2_map: Publish exactly the selected canonical Map FDID 1349477 through the disabled-key build-70450 available-source route. Structural validation, exact partial-extent coverage and zero-fill checks remain fatal on failure; the sealed bytes are the input to offline VMap authentication.
source_policy.partial_sections: Use the v26/v27 available-source declared-skip rules for Map. One or more authenticated E frames must exactly tile every ordered TACT-declared extent, declarations remain per table, and no decryption or key material is admitted.
source_policy.vmap_map_projection: Offline verification reads the sealed Map with read_vmap_maps_70450 and materializes its VMap projection. Section facts and declared/direct/copy/materialized counts and identities are independently re-derived. VMap materialized rows retain WDT==0 rows for complete graph validation; this is deliberately distinct from active_maps and terrain's WDT-nonzero projection.
source_policy.domain: Build Maps::from_materialized_selection over the complete materialized VMap graph with MapSelection::All. Production and verification select every active admitted map, including genuinely empty active maps. No requested_map, numeric sentinel or MapSelection::MapAndAncestors(0) substitutes for All. MapEntry::is_parent is derived from the complete graph before active-map narrowing.
source_policy.active_maps: All and only active admitted Map rows participate in the selected active_maps domain. An active row with no geometry is still covered and must have its tree and placement proof; active emptiness is a source-derived result, not a fallback for an acquisition, parse, association or availability failure. A source with no active rows has an explicitly empty geometry domain and no fabricated map artifacts; selected-map profiles retain their non-empty rule, and no unknown or global coverage is inferred.
source_policy.wdt_zero_rows: Rows with WDT==0 participate in materialization, parent derivation and complete graph validation but are excluded from active_maps and do not acquire a tree or placement proof as active maps.
source_policy.omitted_or_unknown_ids: IDs absent from the admitted materialized source and unknown omitted IDs are never invented, assigned empty geometry, or added to active_maps. Omission caused by unavailable source coverage remains explicit and is not evidence of an empty map.
source_policy.required_active_map_artifacts: Every active admitted map, including an empty one, requires its own vmtree and placements proof with exact map associations. Missing trees or proofs reject production, resume and verification; artifacts are not synthesized for unknown or omitted IDs.
source_policy.source_authentication_flags: full_ckey_verified/CKey and encoded_key_authenticated/EKey are acquisition facts reported by the producer. They remain producer_reported and are not independent cryptographic source authentication or a substitute for sealed-Map re-derivation.
source_policy.gameobjects: GODI and global GameObject startup are excluded by profile policy. No GameObjectDisplayInfo request, global TempList model acquisition or GameObjectModels.dtree output is part of v29; this exclusion is not an observed source failure or cause.
source_policy.models: Only models registered by actual all-active-domain placement requests are converted and published. Placement-only scope requires zero GODI startup reads and an exact used_models/VMO-artifact inventory.
source_policy.liquids: LiquidMaterial and LiquidType retain the selected-geometry source checks. LiquidObject is out of scope and is not requested.
source_policy.failure_policy: An active Map, VMap, graph, placement, model, tree, proof or liquid input that fails authentication, structure, exact declaration coverage, associations or a resource limit remains fatal and is never silently omitted or converted into an empty map.

verification.verify_scope: offline package integrity, intrinsic DB2/VMap formats and associations, exact per-table Map partial declarations, and independently re-derived Map sections, VMap direct/copy/materialized identities, complete graph and MapSelection::All active-map domain
verification.verify_links_scope: the same authenticated all-active-map geometry checks; no terrain, navigation, MMap or external package links are part of v29

verification.map_materialization: materialize the VMap projection while retaining WDT==0 rows for graph validation
verification.parent_derivation: MapEntry::is_parent from the complete materialized graph before active-map narrowing
verification.source_authentication_flags_scope: CKey/EKey acquisition flags are producer-reported facts, not independent cryptographic proof.
verification.inherited_parent_domain: Every ancestor consulted for a tile without its own payload must be active in the selected domain before its payload is accepted; a WDT-zero or unselected parent cannot satisfy inherited associations. Tiles with their own payload retain the existing parent behavior.
verification.offline_empty_source_limit: The verifier does not reread WDT/ADT or source-cell masks. An empty tree/proof proves required artifact presence and intrinsic associations, not that the source was present or readable; distinguishing a genuinely empty source from an acquisition omission remains outside this offline check and is not independently authenticated.

limits.partial_frames_scope: The total retains the v26/v27 ceiling across selected tables, including Map; the per-table ceiling is the existing CASC max_blte_frames limit and is not raised.
limits.partial_frame_coverage: One or more E frames must exactly tile every ordered TACT-declared extent of Map; crossing, missing, extra or inconsistent coverage rejects.
limits.package_total_bytes_equation: checked_add(collision-output-bytes, 17179869184) where 17179869184 is the 16 GiB DB2 ceiling; overflow rejects
limits.meaning: All seven plan budgets and every product ceiling are downward-only. The 128 MiB aggregate, 128 MiB placement, 384 MiB model, 4096-map and 65535-artifact ceilings are not raised. The package ceiling is the checked sum of collision-output-bytes and the 16 GiB DB2 ceiling. No output is truncated, and component state remains provisional until sealed.
